subject.title: ci: pin corrected Kova release evaluator

question: Should this PR wait for a Kova commit that includes final gateway process metrics in the primary gateway resource gate, or should release owners accept that blind spot for this pin?
rationale: The OpenClaw patch is mechanically narrow, but the pinned external evaluator controls a blocking release gate and source inspection shows a remaining blind spot that ordinary OpenClaw CI does not settle.

options.title: Require corrected Kova pin
options.body: Wait for or create a Kova commit that gates final gateway process metrics and update this PR to that immutable SHA before merge.

options.title: Accept temporary gate blind spot
options.body: A release owner may intentionally merge this pin despite the known final-metric gap and rely on separate release sign-off to catch it.

options.title: Pause the pin
options.body: Leave the old Kova pin in place until the evaluator calibration and final-metric contract are reviewed upstream.

recommendation.title: Require corrected Kova pin
recommendation.body: Wait for or create a Kova commit that gates final gateway process metrics and update this PR to that immutable SHA before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the proposed OpenClaw pin and the upstream Kova PR being pinned, so they are the clearest owner for the corrected external SHA or release-risk decision.
